sense.text:
Life after World War III: in the midst of World War III, that’s when Christ is gonna return, and this is where it starts. “Give me the little book”; “Take it, and eat it up”: the little book is the Bible. It is our job to eat the Bible, to learn this Bible.

“And it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.” The sweetness is when you hear you’re going to live forever, that you’re going to rule over the nations and rule this earth. The sweetness is when you read Isaiah 4:1, that in that day seven women gonna grab hold of one man to be called by thy name; you’re like damn, in the kingdom, yo. There’s gonna be no sorrow no more, no pain no more, no stress no more. Once you eat this Bible and understand the promises the Lord has in store for you, it’s sweet. You learn you’re an Israelite, a son of God, chosen by God, and it feels good. When you teaching it and you hear these prophecies, it’s sweet in your mouth; you can’t stop talking about it.

But in your belly it’s bitter, because in learning this you understand the things that are going to take place on this earth before you get them promises. Certain things got to transpire before Christ’s return. Some of us got to be killed, some of us got to die, some of us going to be put in prison, we gonna be hated. Some of your wives is going to leave you because she don’t want to do what this Bible say; some of your kids are going to say dad, mom, I don’t want to do what that Bible say. Sisters leave their husband and say ah, you in a cult, I don’t want all that Israelite stuff, you having me wearing skirts and keeping the sabbaths and I can’t eat pork no more. The bitterness is losing kids, losing family members, being called a cult, and even some of us inside are going to lose our life for Christ’s name’s sake.

The sweetness is the reward you know you’re going to have; but in learning the Bible you also learn all the hell you got to catch in order to get the kingdom. It’s bitter in all of our stomachs, but some of us is going to bear it, and some of y’all is not. When it’s time to go through it, it’s going to be bitter.

“And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up”: this is John the Revelator; he ate up the book, he learned it. “And it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.” His belly was bitter because John the Revelator saw everything that was going to come to pass, and said damn.

“Thou must prophesy again”: when he ate the roll, the Lord told him, everything that you ate and learned, you gonna learn it again and you got to go teach it again to your people. Remember John was not in a good place. He was in prison, exiled on that island, up there in age, and the Lord said you got to eat this roll again and teach it to your people. Imagine John saying I got to go back to this people again, you crazy man. But he got to do what he got to do.

So to eat the roll, or to eat the book, is talking about learning it.

precepts.why:
This explains what eating the book is going into. “Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.” The roll is the Bible. To eat the roll means to learn it, the same way all you brothers are here learning the roll today; right now you are eating the roll.

“So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.” “Cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.” It was in his mouth as honey, because it was sweet: the same sweetness John found in the little book.

“Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel”: this is what you’re gonna have to do after you eat the roll. You learn the Bible, you learn the sweetness of it and you learn the bitterness of it. The bitterness is that you will be hated; the sweetness is the reward you will get when you do what was commanded you to do.

“And speak with my words unto them”: after you learn the Bible, God commands us to go to our people, the house of Israel, and speak God’s words unto them, not your own words. Once you learn it, the Bible says you’re going to be hated and all of that, and then you go forth and teach it to your people.

“For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel.” Once you eat that roll, that’s who you got to go teach, not all nations. You go teach your people. This gospel is a witness against all nations.

“Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine?” Whom will God teach knowledge to, and make to understand his doctrine? “Them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.” The milk is the Bible. Like a baby sucks milk from its mother, to be weaned from the milk is you eating the Bible, sucking on this Bible and getting all the milk out of it. Remember in Peter he said desire the sincere milk of the word, that you may grow thereby: that’s how you grow in this truth, sitting down studying and applying this to your life. That’s whom God is gonna teach his knowledge to.

You dealing with this Bible like it’s a titty and you’re a baby sucking on it all the time. A baby can’t eat solid food; every two hours a baby gotta have some milk. Same thing with us: in order to grow, this Bible is supposed to be your titties, this got to be your milk, the thing you sucking on all the time, not the other thing some of you brothers like. Come up from under your wife all the damn time; you want to grow, you want the kingdom, this is your titty right here. I don’t want no more of your titties, I got the real titties right here; the Lord says I gotta suck on these to get the better milk.

“For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little”: when you study the Bible you learn to put precept upon precept. That’s what the spirit of God is going to teach you to do, and what the leaders over you are going to teach you to do. “For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.” That’s who God is going to teach his doctrine to.

You cannot read the Bible like a novel, because it was written in a way to be a stumbling block for the wicked. You must be taught the Bible by somebody that was taught the Bible. I didn’t just come out of the cosmos understanding this; I was taught by the Bishops, and you all been taught by us. Then you got to study these precepts yourself and make sure you understand for yourself, so you could teach somebody. What you learn, deliver to faithful men that could teach others also. What was delivered to us we deliver unto you, and some of you will be faithful and teach others also.

sense.text:
“Remember the former things of old”: the former things of old are these prophecies our forefathers wrote, the law of Moses and everything our forefathers wrote. That’s how we remember the former things of old, by studying the Bible, not you just sitting down and saying I wonder what happened.

“For I am God, and there is none else”: there is a God, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of the nation of Israel. To hell with them atheists, to hell with these people that say there ain’t no God; they gonna find out the hard way. A lot of black people with all that Egypt garbage want to come against what the Bible is saying: you’re going to learn the hard way.

“Declaring the end from the beginning”: in the beginning, in Genesis, God declared what is going to happen in the end when Christ returns. We just living out a play that was already set up and designed. The Lord already declared what’s going to happen in World War III and what’s going to happen after World War III. It’s up to his servants now to read the Bible, eat the roll, and show the people what’s going to happen and what you must do to escape that destruction that is coming. From all the way in the time of the prophets, they wrote about what’s gonna happen in the end of days; they wrote about World War III.

The Bible prophesied what will happen in the end of the world. The Bible prophesied World War III, World War II, America bringing you Israelites, the so-called Negroes, over here in slavery, Puerto Rico being enslaved, Israelites living on this side of the world and the Spaniards coming in and conquering them, and Christ’s return. But everybody cannot understand what it’s saying; only the prophets or the teachers God set up could understand it, and God got to put the spirit on you to show the people what’s really coming.

The Christian church does not understand this Bible. Ask them about corona, they can’t explain it; we could go into the Bible and explain to you corona. Ask them is America in the Bible, they say no. Ask them is World War III in the Bible, they’re going to say no. These Christians live in a fantasy world, in la la land, but the Bible is a real book. These dumb Christians always try to debate Israelites, saying Deuteronomy 28 happened already before the 1600s, but when it comes to the prophecies they can’t denounce that, because the things we saying is gonna come to pass. This world is coming to an end. World War III is on the way; it might be five years from now, ten, fifteen, twenty years from now, but it’s gonna happen.

So if the Lord declared the end from the beginning, we supposed to be able to go into the Bible and see the end. That’s what we’re going to do: go into the scriptures and see what the Lord says concerning the end. And the Bible is your covering: you keep these laws in the fear of Christ, you stop fornicating, you control them lusts, and you’re going to be defended.

“And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth”. When he said woe, he didn’t mean whoa; woe means destruction. Destruction in World War III.

That first woe is World War I. The second woe is World War II. The third woe is World War III. “By reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels”: them three woes is going into World War I, II and III.

Many wars took place from when John the Revelator was on that island, over 2000 years ago, till now: the white men came and colonized Africa, the Vietnam War, the Iraqi war, wars in the Byzantine Empire, the war that took Rome down. Thousands and thousands of wars. So how do we know it’s talking about World War I and World War II? Some idiots say none of the woes happened as yet. Everybody cannot understand this Bible. World War I and World War II the Bishop went into in depth, and it’s going into World War III, which is gonna come. It ain’t happened yet; it might happen in our lifetime.

precepts.why:
“One woe is past”: remember we just read woe, woe, woe three times, talking about World War I, World War II, World War III. One woe is past: that first woe is World War I. “And, behold, there come two woes more hereafter”: two more woes were supposed to come after.

When the Bishop went over World War I and World War II a couple years back, he broke it down plainly. The prophets saw things like scorpions and tried to explain what they saw; they saw tanks and all of that but didn’t know what it was. Imagine you was alive in that time and the Lord showing you airplanes, tanks and all these things, and you’re like what the hell is this, that look like a scorpion. That’s why when you read Revelation they talk about the scorpion and the tail that hurt men. World War II was explained in the Bible, but the Most High got to give you that understanding in order for you to understand it and explain it.

“The second woe is past”: John the Revelator saw the second woe pass. “And, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.” He went into the first woe and the second woe; the Lord showed him the vision of the first woe passing and the second woe passing. But he didn’t go into the third woe in depth, because the third woe has not took place yet.

sense.text:
This explains that them wars is talking about World War I and World War II. “And there went out another horse that was red”: who is this red horse? It’s talking about Esau, the so-called white man. He’s that red horse. “And power was given to him that sat thereon”: power was given unto the so-called white man.

“To take peace from the earth”: when did the so-called white man take peace from the earth? In World War I and World War II. In World War II they say over 80 million people died. Them was very significant points in history; till this day they still talking about World War I and World War II, not the Vietnam War or the Iraqi war that just took place. The Most High showed John the Revelator those two times in history, and he also showed him what’s going to happen in World War III. Certain things were done in World War II that never been done.

When he was fighting he had his little allies joined together with him, but the allies was garbage. Japan joined with Germany, and to make an example the so-called white man dropped the atom bomb on Japan, that was allied with Germany: you better fall back, see what I got. People were killed in seconds, and the weapons they got today is a million times more powerful than that.

“And that they should kill one another”: that’s the key thing. Them three woes, World War I, II and III, are the heathens, Esau, fighting against himself: the so-called white men fighting against each other. When they went to Africa and colonized Africa, were they killing each other? No. When they came and enslaved us, were they killing each other? No. This is pinpointing those three wars, letting you know when them wars will take place. So if any idiot says World War I and World War II ain’t talking about the woes, you just an idiot; you don’t know the Bible. Go drink some more milk; you grew up on baby formula.

“And there was given unto him a great sword”: it was given unto them a sword, meaning they are the ones creating these weapons. America went to war in Afghanistan, America went to colonize Africa: that’s a regular war. But when you see superpowers start fighting each other, when the white men both got the weapons, God gave them the gift for weaponry and destruction, it’s a different world we living in. Even Trump said I got nuclear weapons, and I think he said he’s scared to use it. Once nuclear war comes and Esau starts using his weapons, it’s a different world. In World War II 80 million people died; in World War III they could wipe out everybody on the face of this planet. Almost everybody on the face of this planet is going to be dead in World War III if the Most High don’t do his divine intervention. In World War III they’re gonna be fighting each other and everybody gonna be casualties of their war.

The sword is his capability to develop weapons. Did the Hamites in Africa develop these weapons? The Chinese, the Japanese? Who invented guns and all of that stuff? The so-called white man, and then the Chinese and Japan and all these other people copy it; Esau had to train them and show them how to make these things, and sell it to them. Weaponry is big business, brothers. Who was given that great sword? Esau. That goes back to Genesis, when it says by the sword shall he live.

precepts.why:
Another precept, proving the first woe and the second woe that already took place are World War I and World War II, those two major wars. When you see Esau start fighting each other, that’s the wars the Bible is talking about.

“Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” The end of Esau’s time should come through them: they’re going to be the ones responsible for destroying the earth with their war, with their nuclear weapons. Them using these weapons, fighting with each other in World War III, destroying each other, destroying the earth and destroying nations. All these weapons they are creating, they going to use it on each other.

Look at what’s going on in Ukraine and Russia right now. Russia ain’t even pulled out the big guns yet, ain’t used no nuclear weapons, ain’t even used some of his higher artilleries. America and all these countries in Europe are sending Ukraine weaponry to fight against Russia. It’s a different stage when white people start warring with each other. But that conflict is not going to start World War III. The Bible says there shall be wars and rumors of wars, many wars, but them three woes are different. The end of their world shall come through them: they creating these weapons of mass destruction, and they’re gonna use it on each other and on other nations.

sense.text:
“For then shall be great tribulation”: that great tribulation is World War III. This is what 2 Esdras means when it says the end of their time should come through them: Esau is creating these weapons of mass destruction, and he’s going to use them on each other and on other nations.

“Such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time”: from the beginning of the world till the time that great tribulation takes place, there was never such a war. A war killing hundreds of millions, billions of people. “No, nor ever shall be”: there will never be such a time of trouble like that again.

“And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved”: meaning everybody gonna be dead. If you leave it up to them, they’re going to wipe out the whole entire world. That’s what it means by the end of their time, their world, should come through them: Esau makes these weapons and he’s gonna use them, and the end of his world gonna come to him through him using these weapons. And it’s not like you just drop the weapon and that’s it; certain things take place after these weapons are dropped, and they continue for years.

What does it mean, except those days be shortened? If it wasn’t for Christ coming back, all flesh would be dead. If Christ does not return, the so-called white man is going to destroy everything on this earth; no flesh gonna be saved, everything gonna die.

“But for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened”: because you’re gonna have righteous brothers and sisters that will be alive in this time. Those days are World War III. We do not know how long it could last: two years, a year, six months, six years. But if the Lord don’t intervene, no flesh gonna be left; the so-called white man will destroy everything and kill everybody with the weapons he has created.

precepts.why:
There’s a lot of precepts that explain except those days be shortened, but this is the one. “Thine Almighty word leaped down from heaven out of thy royal throne”: the Almighty word is Christ. He’s coming from the royal throne, meaning he’s coming back from the third heaven where the Most High dwells. “As a fierce man of war”: he’s coming back for war.

“Into the midst of a land of destruction”: this is the point right here, brothers. When Christ returns, it’s going to be in the midst of World War III. A land of destruction means there’s gonna be destruction everywhere, because of what we read in 2 Esdras, that the end of their time shall come through them. They’re gonna be using these weapons, there’s gonna be war everywhere: bombs being dropped, nuclear bombs being dropped all over the place, nations fighting each other. That’s what will be taking place when Christ returns, and that’s how those days get shortened: he comes back in the midst of it and there’s destruction all over this earth.

sense.text:
We’re going into World War III, and World War III is going to take place whether you believe it or not.

“Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord!” You always have brothers running around saying, I can’t wait for Christ to return. “To what end is it for you?” Are you gonna be rewarded when that day comes? Do you understand what’s gonna happen when the day of the Lord takes place? “The day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.” Some of y’all think you’re going to be happy, Lord Jesus come now, beam me up in the sky, and everything is happy. No, people are going to be dropping dead all around you, even some of your loved ones, brothers in the troop. It’s going to be a day of destruction.

The history in Amos is talking about when Jerusalem was being destroyed, but it’s also going into what’s gonna happen in the last days. It’s twofold.

“As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him”: you’re running from destruction, from what you see is going to take place, and you get met by a bear. That’s for those of y’all that say, I could go live off the grid, I could go to another country, flee Babylon, come out from amongst her my people, let’s leave America and go live in Egypt, or some place where America got less influence. You run to Egypt, and a bomb gets dropped on Egypt, or famine hits Egypt and you starve to death over there.

“Or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him”: you walk into your house, you’re tired, you just lean your hand on the wall, and a serpent bites you. It don’t matter where you go. You can say, I’m going to live in the forest, I’m going off grid, I’m going to live in the bush, live in a tree like Tarzan, I’m getting away from society. Guess what: that destruction is coming everywhere, brothers. Nobody gonna escape it, none of us. The only way we’re gonna be able to escape it is by Christ delivering us, sending his angels to deliver us.
“Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?” It’s gonna be very dark, with no brightness in it.

“For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”. You Christians say you believe the Bible: well, this ain’t talking about you going to hell in the ground and being burned. This is talking about something that’s going to take place on this earth. It’s going to burn like an oven; you’re gonna feel like you’re in an oven.

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: everybody that does wickedly is gonna be burned up. “And the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch”: ain’t no root or branch gonna be left. You ain’t coming back and rebuilding none of that.

Malachi is twofold. It’s talking about Christ burning up the wicked, and it’s also talking about when them bombs drop in America and in certain parts of the world and burn up the wicked.

“But unto you that fear my name”: those are you brothers and sisters that fear God’s name, and to fear his name means you’re keeping his commandments. “Shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings”: you will be protected when that day comes, the day of the Lord that’s going to burn like an oven. “And ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.”
“And ye shall tread down the wicked”. We’re going to jump back to verse 3 later on.

precepts.why:
Now let me show you the day that shall burn as an oven. “Thine Almighty word leaped down from heaven out of thy royal throne, as a fierce man of war”: Christ is coming back for war. “Into the midst of a land of destruction”: there’s gonna be destruction taking place all over the earth when Christ returns.

“And brought thine unfeigned commandment as a sharp sword”: the commandments, the word of God, that’s the sword, the weapon Christ is gonna be using. “And standing up filled all things with death”: when Christ stands up he’s gonna fill all things with death, meaning everybody gonna die. “And it touched the heaven, but it stood upon the earth.” So when he returns he’s gonna fill the place with death. It doesn’t mention fire here, so the next scripture shows how.

sense.text: “And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.”

“And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven”: that man that waxed strong with the thousands of heaven is Christ, coming back with thousands of angels. “And when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him”: everybody is going to tremble when they see Christ return with them angels.

“And whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice”: every time Christ speaks, all the wicked that hear his voice are burnt up. That goes back to Malachi, the day of the Lord cometh where all the wicked shall be burnt up. Malachi is twofold. “Like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.”

“And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”: this is the armies of the earth. Somebody’s gonna gather them together to fight against Christ; the armies of the earth are going to come to fight against Christ, and the names of the main ones are coming.

When it says the man came out of the sea, it’s talking about Christ coming from space. When you read Genesis, the Lord divided the waters from the waters, the waters on earth from the other waters. Space is water.

“But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it. But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.”

“And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid”: all the armies of the earth, when they come together, are gonna be afraid when they see Christ with all the angels. “And yet durst fight”: they’re still gonna fight. Even though they wouldn’t want to fight, he’s going to force them to fight so he can glorify his Son upon this earth. That’s like Pharaoh: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened.

“And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came”: you’ve got to imagine what you’re reading here. The violence of the multitude means they’re using their weaponry on him: the jet planes shooting off missiles, Sidewinders, shooting bullets up in the sky, thousands of missiles, nuclear weapons set to shoot at Christ.

“He neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war”: Christ didn’t lift up his hand, he didn’t pull out a sword, no instrument of war.

“But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire”: Christ is coming back with supernatural power. “And out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.” This is millions of people coming against him.

When you read Malachi, the day of the Lord cometh that shall burn as an oven, that’s twofold: it’s talking about when them nuclear bombs hit, and it’s also talking about when Christ destroys the wicked.

“And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one”. The Lord declared what’s gonna happen to the armies of the earth in the end from the beginning; Ezra saw it: they all gonna be burnt up. Christ is gonna burn them up.

“So that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude”: a number of people you can’t count, “nothing was to be perceived”: nothing was left, not even the boots or shoes, “but only dust and smell of smoke”. Only dust is gonna be left when Christ is done with the armies of the earth.

This is worse than a nuclear weapon, worse than a nuclear bomb: an innumerable multitude that no man could number, and Christ destroys them just by speaking, and everybody gets burned up: sparks coming out of his mouth, fire and tempest, and everybody gets consumed and burnt up.

precepts.why:
“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” When the Lord returns, he’s not coming back like how he came before, as a man. That man that comes out of the sea, that all them armies are going to fight, is not a man; he ain’t coming back like a regular man, he’s coming back like a god on this earth, and he’s gonna use his power.

“I will take vengeance”: what is Christ taking vengeance for? For what you’re going to do to us and what you already did to us, and what they did to him when he came as a man. Judas is gonna be alive, and he’s gonna get it. Them soldiers that pierced him in the side, they gon’ get it. All the wicked, those that plucked his beard out, every last one of y’all gonna get it.

What’s another word for vengeance? Payback. These Christians talk about, Jesus says forgive your enemy, Jesus is love. No: Jesus is coming back for vengeance, and the word vengeance means payback. We’re gonna pay them back for all the evil that they have done.

“I will not meet thee as a man”: Christ is not gonna meet the nations as a man when he returns. He’s coming back for war, and he ain’t coming to do no sword fight with you. In the end he’s gonna get bloody a little too, but in the beginning, that innumerable multitude, the full army of all the earth, he’s just opening his mouth and destroying you all.

When Christ opens his mouth, sparks, tempest, all of that comes out, and he burns up all the armies, that innumerable multitude. So when the Bible says the day cometh that shall burn as an oven, it’s also talking about Christ using the power God gave him to destroy the wicked and the armies of this earth. It’s twofold: it’s also talking about them nuclear bombs that are going to be dropped and kill millions and millions of people.

“And his brightness was as the light”: when Christ returns he’s gonna have a glow on him, like Super Saiyan three. “He had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.” The horns coming out of his hand is that he’s holding back his power. When he’s bringing forth that destruction on the earth he can’t use it all, he can’t even use half of it, because if he did he would destroy the earth, destroy everything. That’s why he just opens his mouth: he just has to yawn and kill everybody. He opens his mouth and says dust, and everything drops dead.

“Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet”: the pestilence is the fire, and burning coal is the same thing we just read in 2 Esdras, when he opened up his mouth and fire and sparks came out. When you look down at his feet, everything looks like burning coals.

“He stood, and measured the earth”: Christ is gonna stand and measure the earth, how much power he needs to destroy the whole earth’s military force. They come at him with violence, stealth airplanes, shooting missiles, and he’s gonna use half of half of half of one percent; he’s got to be careful not to destroy everything. “He beheld, and drove asunder the nations”: he’s gonna destroy all of them. “And the everlasting mountains were scattered”: that’s the nations. “The perpetual hills did bow”: every last one of the nations gonna bow when Christ returns. “His ways are everlasting.”

When is he gonna do this? In the midst of World War III. When you see things intensifying, all the nations are gonna leave the wars they’re fighting with each other and say, we gotta take him down, and that’s when Christ is gonna measure how much power he’s gotta use, and he’s gonna destroy them.

sense.text:
Let me show you what’s gonna happen when Christ destroys them. “Therefore I will shake the heavens”: to shake the heavens is to shake kingdoms, to shake nations.

“And the earth shall remove out of her place.” That goes into islands scattering apart, getting broken into pieces and destroyed, but it’s much more than that: it’s going to be so great that the earth will move off its axis. Christ had to measure the earth and hold back his power, but when Christ uses his power on this earth, the natural way the earth turns right now and the spot where it’s at is going to move. When the Lord shakes the heavens, the earth removes out of her place.

To the common human understanding they think it just means things on the earth move. No: he really means what he says. The whole planet earth is going to move when Christ uses his power. That’s why in Habakkuk he had to measure the earth and hide his power, holding it back; when he uses it, the earth is going to move out of its place.
“For the windows from on high are open”: the windows from on high going into nuclear weapons. “And the foundations of the earth do shake.”

“The earth is utterly broken down”: this is talking about when destruction is taking place. “The earth is clean dissolved”, “the earth is moved exceedingly.” You know how the brother was talking about the earth is flat; that’s how you know: the earth is moved exceedingly.

“The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard”: you know how a drunk can’t walk straight, that’s how the earth is gonna be. “And shall be removed like a cottage”, like a house: you put your house right here and you move it, the earth is gonna move like that with all the destruction that’s gonna be taking place. “And the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it.”

“And it shall fall, and not rise again”: what is the it that shall fall and not rise again? There’s a lot of breaking in this chapter. A brother answers and it’s confirmed, exactly, that’s who it’s going into: they don’t rise no more nor fill the face of the earth with their cities.

“And it shall come to pass in that day”: that day is talking about the midst of World War III. “That the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high”: the high ones is Esau, white, the one that exalts himself above the stars. They are the ones ruling society today. “And the kings of the earth upon the earth”: I’m going to get into the kings of the earth too, and name them.

“And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit”: they’re going to be gathered together as slaves. Remember we’re going over what’s gonna happen after World War III; well, after World War III they gonna be prisoners.

“And shall be shut up in the prison”: this right here is heavy, and it goes into Revelation 20, where the devil was bound for a thousand years. This is when Christ returns. “And after many days shall they be visited”: after the thousand years they’re going to be visited, and that’s for another class.

That day every spirit is going to be chained: a thief spirit, a lying demon, every demon you did not see, they’re going to be in chains that day. Remember in Christ’s time, when he was healing people, the demons were saying it’s not our time yet. That day they all gonna be chained. It’s talking about them demons and it’s talking about Esau.

“Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion”: when the Most High God shall reign on this earth. The Lord of hosts is the Most High God, “and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.”

We went to Isaiah because the earth shall remove out of her place: when Christ returns and uses his power, the earth is going to move. “God is in the midst of her”: her is Israel. “She shall not be moved: God shall help her”: that’s talking about Israel.

“The heathen raged”: remember we read in 2 Esdras 13 that the world will come together to fight against Christ, and when Christ sees them coming with that violence he’s going to destroy them. “The kingdoms were moved”: the kingdoms are the nations of this earth, they’re going to be moved.

“He uttered his voice”: remember what we read early on, when Christ didn’t even raise his hand; all he did was open his mouth, and sparks and tempest came forth and burned everything. This is happening in the midst of World War III: Christ going to utter his voice. “The earth melted”: when Christ utters his voice the earth is gonna melt. That goes back to Habakkuk, when he had to measure the earth and hold back his power.
“The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.”
“Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.” Christ is going to make desolations in the earth: come see what Christ did.

“He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth.” You all want peace on this earth? Christ got to come back and destroy these kings, these nations that’s ruling the earth; that’s the only time there’s going to be peace on this earth. The white man got to go in chains, and the armies of this earth Christ got to destroy; that’s the only time there’s gonna be peace. If anybody’s warring, it’s us warring, the Israelites and Christ, and no nation is going to be warring with each other no more. Unto the end of the earth there’s gonna be peace: ain’t gonna be nobody fighting for no oil and no gold.

“He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder”: the bow and the spear are Esau’s weapons, that sword that was given to him. His technology is going to be destroyed.

“He burneth the chariot in the fire”: that goes back to when Christ opens his mouth and burns everything; everything will melt. The chariot here is their airplanes, their tanks, their artillery. All of that Christ going to burn.

“Be still, and know that I am God”: be still, shut the hell up, and know that I am God. “I will be exalted among the heathen”: the heathens are going to know my name; the time is coming when they will exalt the Lord and his people. “I will be exalted in the earth”: the scripture tells you that every feast day the nations are going to come up to worship the King, and if any one of them nations don’t come up, no rain gonna fall in their land. Why God is going to be exalted in the earth, I’m gonna show you.
“The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge”: that’s who we trust in.

I’m going to show you why the praise of God is going to be on the earth. “The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem”: this is concerning Judah and Jerusalem. This is what’s going to happen to us in the end; this is the prophecy.

“And it shall come to pass in the last days”: the last days is after World War III, after the nations learn peace, after we subdue the nations and force them to serve the God of Israel, because they ain’t gonna do it willingly. What we’re reading here is something that’s going to take place in the future: the Lord is declaring the end from the beginning. The end is that the nation of Israel, you brothers and sisters that repent, are gonna be established over all the nations.

“The mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains”: on the top of the mountains, meaning above all nations. “And shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.”

People ask, are other nations going to be in the kingdom? They don’t care about the Chinese, the Africans or the Arabs; all they care about is, would the white man be in the kingdom. Tell them the kingdom of heaven is for the children of Israel and they say, you racist. The same way we are in their kingdom today, servants working 9 to 5, it’s the same way they’re going to be in the kingdom: servants, hard servants, building up the walls.

“And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways”: all nations going to learn the commandments of God and they’re going to do them, every last one of these nations. There will be no homosexuals on this planet earth, no more lesbians, no more thief, no more nations warring with each other, because all nations gonna learn this. When the sabbath day comes there will be no buying and selling on the planet earth. His ways are the commandments; we’re going to teach them the commandments.

“And we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.”

“And he shall judge among the nations”: that’s Christ. Christ is going to destroy the nations, as we read early on. Before the mountain of the Lord’s house can be established, Christ got to return and judge among the nations, and that’s in the midst of World War III. “And shall rebuke many people”: the many people are the nations, being rebuked.

“And they shall beat their swords into plowshares”: didn’t we just read that in Psalms? Their swords are their weapons, and they’re gonna turn them into farming equipment. Why? Because they’re going into slavery: time to plow the field. “And their spears into pruninghooks”: they gonna make farming equipment out of their weapons.

“Nation shall not lift up sword against nation”: when Christ returns and destroys these nations and rules this earth with the Israelites, nations are not going to be fighting with each other no more. You got China and Taiwan, Pakistan and India, Russia and Ukraine fighting; that ain’t gonna be happening no more.

“Neither shall they learn war any more”: Christ got to conquer these nations and destroy them, and that’s the only way nations ain’t going to learn war anymore. What we’re reading about here is the kingdom of heaven. When you so-called black men are ruling this earth, once you brothers stop fornicating and do what’s right, when Christ returns he’s gonna give you that power to rule these nations, and you’re gonna rule them righteously. They’re going to come up and learn the laws of the Most High God; all the nations gonna praise him, but they gonna be forced. Esau is gonna be in the kingdom, for a time, but that’s another topic.

We just went into the future and came back: that’s where the Bible is. That’s why the scripture says declaring the end from the beginning; I’m giving you all the end.

Remember in 2 Esdras 13 all the armies from the four winds of the earth, that innumerable multitude, come against Christ with much violence. Who is that army? That’s what I’m going to show you.

“And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth”: this beast is America. You read about the seven heads and ten horns; America is the eighth. “And is of the seven”: the seventh head is Great Britain, and America came from Britain. “And goeth into perdition”: perdition means destruction. America is gonna come into power and then go into destruction.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet”: these kings have not received any kingdom as yet. “But receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: one hour with the beast is with America, meaning for a time they’re gonna be ruling with America.

“These have one mind”: the European nations formed what’s called the European Union, and they all have one mind. For Ukraine to be inducted into the European Union, every last one of them has to agree. When they first started there were only 10 nations; go into the history and look it up. That’s why we refer to them as the 10 horns. Today it’s much more than 10, but in the beginning it was only 10.

“And shall give their power and strength unto the beast”: they gave their strength and their power to America after World War II, when they formed the NATO alliance: if you attack one, you attack all. America is the head over all of them, with armies and military in all their countries. Not just that, financially: when they formed the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank and the world monetary system, they put America at the head over it, and they use the America dollar to trade and buy and sell internationally. That’s how America became the superpower on the earth: they gave their power to the beast, which is America.

“These shall make war with the Lamb”: look up and see who formed the European Union. They are the ones that are going to make war with Christ when he returns. When you read 2 Esdras 13 about that multitude that came against him with violence, it’s talking about France, Germany, London, Greece, all these European countries. All the armies are going to come together from the four winds, they’re going to be scared, and they’re still going to come against Christ with violence, and Christ going to destroy them without even lifting a sword: he gonna just open his mouth and destroy them.

“And the Lamb shall overcome them”: didn’t we read that in 2 Esdras 13? That innumerable multitude that comes against him, he will destroy them. “For he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.” You ain’t just called, you are chosen, and you are faithful. Some people are called to this truth but they’re not gonna be chosen, because they were not faithful. It all goes hand in hand.

“The waters which thou sawest”: the waters are the nations, “peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” The one that sits upon the waters here is America. First we referred to America as the eighth beast; now America is referred to as the one that’s sitting upon many waters.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate” her: the ten horns are Europe, and they’re gonna hate America. Something is gonna happen that’s gonna cause the European Union to hate America. Right now they got that NATO alliance going on, and you see it already start dissolving: Macron, the president of France, they call him the emperor of Europe, he’s against America, he’s trying to develop a European army so they don’t have to depend on America. Pay attention, prophecy is being fulfilled.

“And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” What kind of fire? Nuclear fire. America is gonna be burned with nuclear fire, by the ten horns, the European Union, the ten common markets.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast”: God put it in their hearts to give their kingdom unto the beast, “until the words of God shall be fulfilled.”

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city”. She is that great city, and that great city is America, the greatest city on the planet earth. That’s the prophecy: America is going to be burned with fire.

But even though this place is gonna be destroyed with fire, the military is not gonna be destroyed. America got hundreds of bases all over the world, navy bases, silos, all kind of missile systems implanted all over the world. In the case of nuclear war, all the kings and the nobles and the generals are gonna be alive, running the country and running the military from behind the scenes. It’s the regular civilians, the people that was in la la land, that are gonna be burnt up here in America. We that’s here living in America are going to be delivered by the angels.

precepts.why:
“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed by fire, but when you read the Bible and go into the history, ancient Babylon was destroyed from within: the Persians planted men within Babylon and overthrew them. Everything was intact, the palace, everything; it was not destroyed by fire. So the Babylon that is going to be destroyed by fire is America. That’s why the scripture is twofold.

“It shall never be inhabited”: is ancient Babylon inhabited today? Yeah, that’s Iraq; it’s still inhabited today. So this Babylon, when it’s destroyed, will never be inhabited again. That is the burning with fire in Revelation 17:16: America burned and never inhabited again.

This shows how America gets destroyed by the ten horns. “The great and mighty clouds” that are lifted up “full of wrath” are Europe. “And the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell therein”: the star is a nuclear missile. They shall make all the earth afraid, “and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star”.

“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” These clouds are the ten horns of Revelation 17, going steadfast to Babylon to make her afraid. “They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her”: Europe, France, Germany and all of them are going to pour out upon America. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven”.

America is gonna be destroyed by thermonuclear destruction. That’s the prophecy, brothers: Europe is going to turn against America and destroy America with thermonuclear destruction. That is the burning with fire of Revelation 17:16.

Even though America is destroyed, this shows what’s going to be taking place. “Thou as unhappy shalt come through the sea”: who is unhappy here? America. America’s navy is gonna come through the sea; it’s going into the submarines and navy ships. America got military bases, submarine bases, and ships that be at sea for years, so even though America is destroyed its military is not going to be destroyed. The government is gonna still be there telling them what to do. “And receive plagues again”.

“And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city”: the idle city is China. “And shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory”: they’re going to destroy a portion of China and consume part of China’s glory. It didn’t say the whole of China; certain parts of China won’t be destroyed.

“And shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” After this naval force destroys China, a third part of Asia, they return back to Babylon. So the American naval forces are still gonna be running, and they’re given orders to go and destroy China, because even though this country itself is bombed with nuclear destruction, the government that’s governing America is going to still be intact, controlling the military from different parts of the world.

sense.text:
Remember, when a scripture says the day cometh that shall burn as an oven, it’s two different things. It’s talking about when Christ uses his superpower when he comes back, opens his mouth and burns everybody up with his blast; and it’s going into the nuclear destruction, like what we just read about America being burned with fire by the ten horns, the European Union, and a certain part of China being destroyed. That’s another form of the fire Malachi is talking about.

“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”. A smith usually makes weapons, but this smith is a scientist, not just a regular scientist, a nuclear scientist. “And I have created the waster to destroy”: God says he created the waster to destroy.

This prophecy was fulfilled. Not just any nuclear scientist, but that demon who made the bomb: he said himself that he had become death, the destroyer of worlds. Remember what we read in 2 Esdras, that the end of their world should come through them. When he created this bomb he fulfilled this prophecy; the prophecy is talking about him. He said he became the destroyer of worlds, and the weapon that this demon created is the destroyer. He called it the destroyer of worlds; the Bible calls it the waster, the destroyer.

We have to look beyond the flesh with these people. Where would he find the mathematics to even create something like that? Who gave him the math? He was dealing with demons, and then he acknowledged, this is me. That’s what the Lord said: I created him to do that. God created the scientists to develop this weapon, and guess what, they’re going to use it on themselves.

precepts.why:
The nuclear bomb, the atom bomb, is called the waster or the destroyer. “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day”: the Bible also calls it an arrow or a star. The Bible got many different terms for that nuclear weapon; it’s called an arrow because when it shoots up in the air it looks like an arrow.

“Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” The destruction is the destroyer, the same destroyer we read about in Isaiah 54:16, the waster these scientists created.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand”: what’s got the power to kill a thousand people on one side of you and ten thousand on your right hand? That’s talking about the waster. “But it shall not come nigh thee”: it ain’t touching you, because the Lord is going to protect you.

“For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood”. Every battle of the warrior, when people go to war, like them long-time wars, is with confused noise, and everybody’s garment is in blood. “But this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.” This battle is the battle that’s gonna take place in World War III, with burning and fuel of fire. That’s when Christ uses that fire and destroys the nations. It ain’t gonna be using no guns, none of that; it’s gonna be just burning. When they come against him he’s gonna just open his mouth and burn them all up.

“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given”: that’s talking about Christ. This tells you who will burn them up. “And the government shall be upon his shoulder”: the government is Christ and the 144.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise”. That great noise is boom: that’s when they drop them bombs. The bombs are not going to be dropped all over the earth, they’re going to be dropped in certain places. When Christ comes in the midst of that war, the armies are going to come together to fight against him, but Babylon, this country, is already going to be destroyed and we are going to be delivered up out of here. There are going to be wars in different places of the earth; after America is destroyed they’re going to be angry and destroy certain parts of China. The Lord is not going to wait so long that they end up destroying everything.

“And the elements shall melt with fervent heat”: fervent heat is that heat. “The earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.” That’s talking about when them nuclear bombs drop here in America, and it’s talking about when Christ destroys the wicked, the armies that come against him. Christ is going to use that fire and burn everybody up. Everybody that’s living in America here is going to be burnt up when Europe drops them bombs on America, except for the elect. The elect will be delivered up out of here.

sense.text:
“And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time”. That time of trouble is Jacob’s trouble, the sixth trump: World War III, the third woe.

“And at that time thy people shall be delivered”: Daniel’s people are gonna be delivered from that destruction that’s gonna be taking place here. When Europe drops them bombs on America, we’re gonna be delivered through that.

What’s so crazy is you always see a dumb Christian talking about, I’m saved; brother, are you saved, sister, are you saved; come let me dip you in some water. They dip people in a pool where people pee in that pool water and say, you are clean, you are saved. And every last brother and sister that left IUIC being evil, all of them went and got baptized. How is dipping yourself in water gonna save you from them nuclear bombs that’s about to hit this place? Ducking yourself in a pool ain’t gonna save you from thermonuclear destruction.

The problem is that a lot of brothers and sisters come from Christianity. Many are called but few are chosen: a lot of people been called in here from Christianity, and growing up your grandmom told you that in order to get the kingdom of heaven you have to be dipped in water. That thought is still in their mind, so they come into Israel and ask to be baptized. Hell no: I’m baptizing you right now, teaching you the laws of God. Which baptism you want, John’s baptism or Christ’s baptism? He that cometh after me shall baptize you with fire: that’s the baptism I want. Every last one of them that leaves up out of here has been water baptized, and you see them burning ganja and all type of stuff; it’s like they got baptized back into being the damn devil.

“The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us”: baptism does save you. “Not the putting away of the filth of the flesh”: being dipped in a pool or in a river is putting away the filth of the flesh. “But the answer of a good conscience”: this is Christ’s baptism. You must change the way you think; you must change inwardly.

You a homosexual and you dip yourself in water, you just a wet, clean homosexual. You a lesbian, you dip yourself in water; you a thief, you dip yourself in water, you just a clean thief. Your body is clean, like taking a shower, and that’s all it is.

The key thing is having the answer of a good conscience toward God. Are you committing adultery? Are you murmuring? Are you speaking evil of dignities? Are you a Judas, did you turn against the men God used to bring you into this truth? Brother, are you beating your wife? Sister, are you disrespecting your husband? If Christ came back right now, was you disrespecting your husband last night, and did you repent for that? Dipping yourself in water don’t give you a good conscience. What gives you a good conscience is keeping these commandments.

A lot of you are listening to these dumb questions because you still got the dumb thoughts of Christianity and you never changed. That’s why when the devil comes for you, you go back to the vomit, like Peter says. We had a captain amongst us that left because he wanted water baptism: go, and see if that’s gonna save you from them bombs that’s coming.

“I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I”. That’s the key they don’t get. Christ is mightier than John. “Whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost”: not with water, with the Holy Ghost. This is John himself speaking, saying Christ will baptize you with the Holy Ghost, “and with fire”. That’s the part you want, brothers.

Christ is going to baptize you with the Holy Ghost, which is the Holy Spirit. Every last one of you brothers that woke up to the truth that you are Israel and are learning this Bible got the Holy Spirit in you: you have been baptized.

And with fire: we fight fire with fire. Even this scripture is twofold. When it says he’s gonna baptize you with fire, you got to be tried in the fire, and that’s not the only fire you got to go through.

“Whose fan is in his hand”: this is talking about Christ. “And he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner”. He’s gonna terribly burn up this earth, and as this earth is being burned up he’s gonna gather the wheat. The wheat are you brothers and sisters that been keeping the commandments, that have been baptized in the blood of Jesus, with the spirit of Christ dwelling in you. He purges the floor with that fire, when them bombs hit.

Dipping yourself in water is not gonna deliver you from that destruction that’s coming. You must clean yourself inwardly. You must clean your mind: you can’t be carrying hatred, grudges, or bitterness towards your brothers; you can’t be an adulterer, a thief, a murmurer, a gossiper. You must have a good conscience towards God, and you must get rid of Christianity. A lot of you Christians are waking up to this truth, but you must shake that off. Water just cleans the outside flesh; it’s within the soul you must be cleansed. These things in you need to be burned up, the purification out of you.

If I’m dealing evil with you, brother, if I stole something from you, spoke evil about you or murmured against you, and Christ comes back tonight, do I have a good conscience? You think I’m getting the kingdom? Hell no. The Holy Spirit in me is gonna be like, damn bro, you messed up.

“But he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.” The chaff that’s gonna be burnt up is the wicked: those of you that think being dipped in the water is going to get you in the kingdom. You must change your inward parts and have a good conscience towards God if you want to survive what’s coming. You want to survive World War III, you got to do what’s right: keep the commandments and the faith of Christ.

precepts.why: What does the water represent? “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word”. By the word: the water is symbolic, it represents the word of God. And yet a brother left the truth because he wanted to be baptized with water, when John himself tells you Christ will baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire.

“For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.” If you are acceptable, brothers, you are that gold, and you’re going to be tried in fire. When you are baptized and you got the Holy Spirit on you, now you got to go through that fire, that furnace of adversity, to make you pure.

sense.text:
This goes into the same thing just read: Christ’s fan is in his hand, he will throughly purge his floor, gather his wheat into the garner and burn up the chaff, the wicked. If you want to survive World War 3 you’ve got to do what’s right: keep the commandments and the faith of Christ, and have a good conscience towards God.

“In all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die”: that is talking about right here in America. “But the third shall be left therein”: the third is the part that is going to be delivered.

“And I will bring the third part through the fire”: the third part is brought through the fire while them bombs are dropping. That is the time of Psalms 91, when they fall on one side and on the other side and it shall not come near you. Nuclear bombs going off, and you are floating, going up into the sky, and the fire is not touching you.

precepts.why: “Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” The Lord is going to command the angels to gather the saints together unto him. Those of us that are alive, the angels are going to come and guide us together, and while they are gathering us together we are being brought through the fire.

This shows what is going to happen as we come through the fire. “For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God”: the same archangel we read about in Daniel 12.

“And the dead in Christ shall rise first”: this is what they call a rapture. It means those brothers and sisters that died are going to come back alive.

“Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds”: we are not going into a rain cloud and standing in the midst of it. The cloud here is a chariot. What this world calls UFOs, the Bible calls a cloud, or chariots.

“To meet the Lord in the air”: when Christ comes back he is coming back with chariots, and he is going to be in the air, and we are going to meet him in the air. “And so shall we ever be with the Lord.”

This shows what is taking place as the angels deliver us, as the brothers and sisters come back to life and are caught up in the air, and as we go through the fire. “Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed”. The reason that fire isn’t going to touch none of us that make it is because we are going to be changed. You won’t be feeling pain no more; nothing can hurt you no more.

“In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump”: when that trumpet blows, the sixth trump. “For the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible”: the dead rise with an incorruptible body. The dead in Christ rise first, those alive are caught up with them, and where we’re going we’re going to have an incorruptible body. That’s why the fire is not going to touch us: we go through the fire, going up in the chariot, “and we shall be changed.”

“For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality”: an immortal body. When we are being delivered through that destruction, we are going to be changed right there; we are going to be immortal. That’s sweet in the mouth, but we all have to go through some bitterness to get that.

“Then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory. O death, where is thy sting?” I feel no pain: the fire, the nuclear bombs are going off, and nothing is burning me. “O grave, where is thy victory?”

“The sting of death is sin”: that is heavy. Brothers, the sting of death is sin; that is why the scripture speaks of the wages of sin. “And the strength of sin is the law”: that’s how you overcome sin, by the law. “But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ”: we are able to overcome death through Christ.

sense.text:
“For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved”: the earthly house of this tabernacle is our bodies, our temple, and it’s going to be changed. This body holds us. “Were dissolved”: you die and turn into dust.

“We have a building of God, an house not made with hands”: a body that was not made with hands. In Genesis the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground; this other body was not made of this earth, of flesh. It is the body God created for us.

“Eternal in the heavens”: that is not the kingdom. We have a house, a body, that is eternal in the heavens. A lot of times we ask ourselves what the Bible is talking about when it says we’re going to be changed in the twinkling of an eye. It means the Lord is going to give us that body he has prepared for us.

Read it again with John the Baptist in mind. Was his earthly house dissolved? Yes: they cut his head off. But “we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.” That is what John came back with when he appeared unto Christ: his eternal body, the body in heaven, his eternal spiritual body.

“For in this we groan”: we groan in this body we are living in because this body is susceptible to sin. You keep messing up; you’re trying to do right, but you keep messing up, so you’ve got to keep going off of forgiveness and pray he don’t kill you.

“Earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven”: we want to be clothed with our spiritual body. Pay attention to the word he used: “our house”. Our house means we had it before, and now our desire is to have it back. Our house is in heaven.

precepts.why:
The transfiguration, where Luke goes into it a little more. Christ took Peter and John and James up into a mountain to pray, “and as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.”

“And, behold, there talked with him two men”: this is read to explain that we have a building in heaven not made with hands, eternal. “Which were Moses and Elias”: what had just happened to Elias before that? He got his head cut off as John the Baptist. John the Baptist and Elijah are the same person, so John the Baptist was there talking to Christ, though he had just died not too long before.

“Who appeared in glory”: in what? In glory. They came down in their heavenly form.

“No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper”: once we put on that spiritual body, no weapon formed against us shall prosper. When we are changed in the twinkling of an eye, the Lord is going to give us our house that was prepared for us in heaven, our spiritual body, the same body that Elijah and Moses had when they saw Christ.

“And every tongue that shall rise against thee”, “thou shalt condemn”: we are going to condemn every tongue that rises up against us.

So in all of that: we are going to be delivered through the fire, we are going to be caught up in the air, and the Most High is going to give us our spiritual body. All of that is taking place in World War 3.

sense.text:
This is what takes place once we get caught up in the air. “And I will bring you out from the people”: we are going to be brought out from amongst the people we were living among. When that war takes place and them bombs drop, the angels are going to deliver us, we are going to be changed in the twinkling of an eye, and we are going to be brought up from amongst the people.

“And will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out”: he is going to be doing a lot of killing while he is delivering us. He is telling the angels to deliver us while he is killing people and destroying armies.

“And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people”: after World War III, after Christ destroys the armies of the earth, the Israelites, you so-called Negroes, Puerto Ricans, North American Indians, you children of the slave trade, will be taken into the wilderness, the same way we were in the wilderness with Moses. That is why Paul keeps warning us in Corinthians not to murmur like our forefathers in the wilderness and not to be adulterers like our forefathers in the wilderness: Paul understood that we are going back into the wilderness again.

“And there will I plead with you face to face”: Christ is going to teach us face to face. He is going to say, this is what this means; that new moon you see bright in the sky, that’s a new moon. Some people are going to make it up out of here, but they are not going to get the kingdom.

“Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God”: the same way the Lord pleaded with us when he brought us out of Egypt, he will plead with us again.

“And I will cause you to pass under the rod”: the rod is correction. Christ is going to teach us the laws, and nobody better say nada. Where Christ says, ‘these my enemies that don’t want me to rule over them, bring them hither and slay them before me’, that is talking about the wilderness. Say Christ returns and tells a deacon, you are over everybody here, you are one of the twelve, and gives him an order. And you say, I want to talk to Christ, I don’t want to hear what he says; I know this dude from back in Babylon, I never really liked this dude. They won’t necessarily be coming against Christ: it is the men that Christ set up that they are going to be fighting against in the wilderness. The same thing will happen again; they will be murmuring, and some people are going to be delivered up out of here just to be made an example of.

“And I will bring you into the bond of the covenant”: the new covenant. We are under the new covenant right now; that is why we are able to repent, and why we are not put to death if we commit adultery. But Christ is going to bring us under the bond of the new covenant.

“And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me”: there are going to be people in the wilderness that are rebellious, that murmur, that still want to fornicate, that speak evil and hate dignities. The Lord is going to purge them out from amongst us, and this happens in the wilderness.

“I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn”: Christ will bring you out from there, the chariots are going to come and deliver you, and you’ll be like, I made it, damn, I did some evil stuff the day before yesterday, how come I made it? And you are going to be brought into the wilderness.

“And they shall not enter into the land of Israel”: you are not going to enter into the kingdom. So brothers and sisters, making it up out of Babylon is not the end of it. Those that transgress the law are going to die.

There are going to be different levels. The 144 is going to be on another level, and the 12 on another level. Them that transgress is not talking about the 144 or the 12; it is talking about that mixed multitude that no man could number. The scripture says the 144 are going to be like the gods on the earth; other people will live forever, but the 144 and the 12 are on another level.

precepts.why:
“Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide”: the wide is the kingdom, and the strait things are the struggles we have to go through in this walk.

“For they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.” There are going to be people that do wickedly and still suffer strait things: they are in this truth, they might be put in prison for teaching the gospel, and they might make it up out of here, and they still aren’t going to get the kingdom, because they are going to be purged out in the wilderness.

This is the bond of the covenant, the new covenant. “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days”: after World War III. “Saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind”: that is the covenant he is going to make with us. His laws will be in our minds; nobody will be talking about, I didn’t know that. Everybody is going to know the laws of God.

“And write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people”. That is the bond of the new covenant: the Lord is going to make sure you keep his laws, put his laws in your mind and teach you face to face. That is him bringing us under the bond of the covenant, and it takes place after World War III.

Some will ask: if we are going to be changed into our immortal body, how is it we are going to die in the wilderness? This shows how. Even if you are immortal, you can be taken out, because a god can kill a god.

“O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory? The sting of death is sin”. So if you are in the wilderness transgressing God’s law, guess what: you are going to die.

sense.text:
This is what happens after we are changed, after we are in the wilderness and Christ teaches us the law. “It shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them”.

The land of the north is North America, Babylon the great. This place is going to be destroyed with nuclear destruction, and that is where we are going to be delivered from. The third that goes through the fire is here in Babylon.

“And I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers”: we are going to be brought again into our land. But before we are taken into our land, Christ is going to take us into the wilderness first and teach us face to face, and make sure everybody is on one accord. He is going to tell the 12 what to do, and they are going to let you all know, this is what you’ve got to do. Everything is going to be plain, with nobody giving a different breakdown, because Christ will make it plain. You won’t be looking through a glass darkly no more.

“Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them”: Christ says, ‘I will make you fishers of men.’ The fishers are the teachers going forth and teaching the people: teaching you to repent, teaching you that you’re an Israelite.

“And after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.” After Christ takes us into the wilderness and teaches us the law, he is going to send us forth to hunt. We won’t be fishing no more, we are going to be hunting. Christ is going to give us power over the nations, to rule them with a rod, and they shall be beaten to pieces. After Christ brings us under the bond of the covenant and the rebels amongst us are purged out, then we go forth hunting.

“And after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them”: we are going to hunt them, “from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.” The holes of the rocks are where the rulers and the rich of this world are going to be hiding after World War III. This is life after World War III.

precepts.why:
“And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains.” That is what the holes of the rocks in Jeremiah are going into: secret government bunkers, ready for nuclear war. They are going to be hiding in these places, but guess what: they are going to be hunted, hunted by the Israelites.

The government has bunkers set up for World War III, where the US government could go and be there for years, some known and some secret. If you are working in the government and you don’t know where that bunker is, you are not invited; you federal agents, you are not invited. The show where they had a place in the mountain where the people were hiding from the nuclear fallout, that is real. And the super rich have their doomsday bunkers: you got to pay millions of dollars for bunker space, stocked with food. The super rich understand what time it is. They want to survive the end of days with technology. That is where the kings, the senators, the president are going to be. When you look at the white man, just to have the thought of escaping the judgment is evil.

But we are going to hunt them. We are going for them up inside these mountains where they are hiding. We are going to be seeing through the mountains and see where they are, breaking through them stones.

Read verse 15 again. “The kings of the earth”: the politicians, the senators, the rulers of this earth. “The rich men”: people with millions of dollars. “Every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens”: some poor people are literally going to go down in dens and holes when that thing happens. “And in the rocks of the mountains”: the government is going into the mountain. That is why, even though America is going to be destroyed, they are still going to coordinate an attack to destroy a certain part of China: the military will still be operational because the government will still be operational, living in these holes, these caves, these mountains.

“And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne”: they are going to be hiding from Christ. But Christ is going to leave a little action for us. Christ is going to say, go get them.

That is where Isaiah comes in. A lot of times you see Israelite brothers getting their boots kissed. Most of the regular white people and these heathens are going to die; the ones that survive World War III, ninety-nine percent of them, are going to be kings, governors, princes, rich people, like what we just read in Revelation. A regular poor person on the street is not making it. So when Isaiah says they shall bow down at your feet, it is talking about governors, nobles, princes and kings, because they are the ones going to be hiding in the rocks. They are the ones that got these bunkers to escape the destruction, to escape Christ when he returns. They think they could hide from Christ, but we are going to hunt them.

“To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people; To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron.”

Why are their nobles going to be bound with fetters of iron? Because they are the ones that are going to remain after World War III. They are going to be in them cliffs and in them rocks, hiding, and we are going to go get them.

sense.text:
This goes into what happens with the other nations after World War III. “Immediately after the tribulation of those days”: after World War III.

“Shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light”: first and foremost the sun and the moon are going into their wisdom, which is their technology. When Christ returns, the first thing he is going to take out is their satellites.
