The satellites are what is being used for the television and for your phone calls, and all of that is going to be cut off when Christ returns, because the first thing he is going to destroy is all these thousands of satellites around the earth.

“And the stars shall fall from heaven”: these are satellites falling from heaven, and nuclear bombs, nuclear missiles falling from the heaven. The prophet saw a bright light, a bright fire in the sky coming down on the earth, and said it was a star falling from heaven. But a star is big like the earth, so it is not a literal celestial star.

“And the powers of the heavens shall be shaken”: the nations, the kingdoms of this earth, are going to be shaken when these bombs hit the ground.

It is not just the Lord destroying their technology. What they call a nuclear winter is going to happen after World War III: when the nuclear bombs drop, the smoke goes up into the atmosphere and creates a cloud, and that cloud blocks out the sun and blocks out the moon. “Shall the sun be darkened”: the sun will be darkened because of the nuclear winter. “And the moon shall not give her light”: you are not going to see the moon, because them nuclear clouds are going to be blocking it out. This is what the prophet saw: he looked up and couldn’t see the sun nor the moon during the tribulation of them days.

precepts.why: “Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine. The light shall be dark in his tabernacle”: that is going into the sun and the moon going dark. “And his candle shall be put out with him.” This is talking about Esau, Esau being destroyed.

“And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations”: the wicked inventions of those nations are their technology, their satellites, their missile systems, and Christ is going to rebuke all of it. So when it says the sun and the moon shall not give their light, first and foremost it is talking about their wisdom, which is their technology.

sense.text:
“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: who exalts themselves as the eagle? Esau. America.

“And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: brothers in the class said that is their satellites, their space stations, their space force, all their military they are going to have in space. That is right, but there is more to it. Look at the word nest: ‘a place of rest, retreat or lodging’. The underlying word is home. A bird’s nest is its home, where it goes. So when Obadiah says they set their nest among the stars, it is talking about a home among the stars: house colonies.

In 1969 America went to the moon, planted their flag on the moon and said ‘the eagle has landed’. That was the beginning of them fulfilling this prophecy. After that they built a space station, and you got white people and astronauts literally living in space. When America went to the moon it did not live there; it planted the flag and came back to the earth. But it goes further than that. The technology is getting better and better: SpaceX, the company of the richest man in the world, builds space shuttles for NASA, and they are trying to build colonies on Mars, and they have the technology to do it. That is what “set thy nest among the stars” is talking about: the so-called white man colonizing other planets. The white man is going to establish a colony on Mars soon. That is a prophecy. First it started with America and Neil Armstrong going to the moon, then the space station, now it is being taken further, to colonies on Mars.

That richest man got Satan on him, a demon working with him. When the bible speaks of ‘spiritual wickedness in high places’, one of them demons in high places is working with him. That is why he is the richest man in the world, and why he is coming up with these technologies and ideas. He himself said that if there is a third world war we will likely enter dark ages, and they want ‘a seed of human civilization somewhere else’ to bring civilization back. The dark ages was when negroes was ruling Europe; then you had the renaissance, the rebirth of the white nation. So he understands that World War III is going to issue into dark ages, and it is not because of pestilence, as they try to say: more people die from corona and AIDS and all these diseases than ever died of any disease in that time. To bring civilization back means to bring back their technology, the white race ruling.

But “thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” The first place Christ is going to destroy is up there. When Christ comes back he is taking out the satellites and whatever colony they got set up on Mars. They are going to be destroyed up there in the heavens.

precepts.why:
“Whose voice then shook the earth”: Christ’s voice is going to shake the earth. “But now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only”: Christ is not going to shake up this earth only, “but also heaven.”

Why also the heavens? Because they are going to have colonies up there, living in space. That is why the scripture says “thence will I bring thee down”: they are going to be destroyed up there in the heavens.

The Lord shaking the earth here speaks of back in the time of Moses, when the Lord spoke and the earth shook. But it also goes into the destruction in the last days, when the Lord is going to shake the earth, and everything on this earth is going to be destroyed.

sense.text: This is what is going to happen after World War III. “And there fell a great star from heaven”: that star is a nuclear bomb, “burning as it were a lamp”, and it fell “upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters.”

“And the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.” Made bitter means made poisonous. The water supply is going to be poisoned after World War III, and people are going to die from drinking the water.

But at that time we are going to be transformed. That is what is going to happen to the other nations, but we are going to be delivered.
“Even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.” This is after World War III.

“For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.” Some people are going to die from famine, and some are going to die by the sword, meaning the war.

“And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them”: no man is going to be there to bury them. “For the earth shall be wasted”: this is after World War III. “And the cities shall be cast down”: the cities are going to be destroyed.

“There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it”: in certain places of the earth there is not going to be nobody left to farm. “The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?” The trees are going to give fruit and nobody is going to be there to gather it; the fruit is going to be falling off the tree. “The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them?” Nobody is going to be there to pick the grapes.

“For all places shall be desolate of men”: after World War III all places are going to be desolate of men for a time, because they are going to start to multiply again. And we are going to go get them, after Christ brings us under the bond of the covenant and tells us, go forth.

“So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.” You are going to be like, damn, I didn’t see nobody in six months. This is after World War III: one man is going to desire to see another man, to hear somebody else’s voice.

“For of a city there shall be ten left”: of one city with millions of people in it, there are going to be ten people left. “And two of the field”: two of the people that were in the field are going to be left. “Which shall hide themselves in the thick groves”: the only reason they escape is because they hide themselves deep down in the forest, deep down in some holes, in some caves. “And in the clefts of the rocks”: some people are going to go into the rocks and hide, and some that built bunkers are going to be hiding in there. That is the only reason they are going to survive.
“Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword”: people are going to be raving through houses looking for food and such.

“And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns.” All these roads you see: like in I Am Legend, the grass growing on the buildings and the roads covered up with weeds. That could take place in one to two years, with nobody cutting the grass; everything gets overgrown. “Because no man shall travel therethrough”: nobody is going to be traveling there no more.

“The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms”, because she ain’t getting no penis; she is going to die a virgin. “The women shall mourn, having no husbands”: why? They are all dead in World War III. “Their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers”: their daughters ain’t got nobody to help them.

“In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed”: in the wars that are going to take place in World War III. Most of the men are going to be killed in the wars.

They are going to make it mandatory to go to war. They are going to draft everybody: you are a young man, you can fight, and they are going to try to put a gun in your hand and say go to war. Brothers, at that time you got to kill me; I ain’t going. They are getting ready to fight against Christ, and the bible already tells me you are going to lose. I ain’t going to fight no war for America. The bible says you are going to blow you all up, and then Christ is going to destroy Europe.

“And their husbands shall perish of famine”: some husbands are going to die from hunger.
“Hear now these things and understand them, ye servants of the Lord.” Brothers and sisters, all you listening: hear what is coming on the earth, and understand these things.
